query: Create a method for comparing two household washing machines sold in the EU and US using energy, water, capacity, cycle duration, and labeling information, while explaining why headline annual-cost figures may not transfer between households or countries.

requirements.text: 1. Normalize energy consumption to a comparable usage basis.
2. Compare water consumption and rated capacity.
4. Explain the relevant EU and US label fields and test-basis differences.
5. Explain why annual operating-cost estimates depend on usage patterns and local utility prices.
